mainEntity.name: Can a beginner use AI for affiliate marketing without already having a big audience?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can support affiliate marketing through offer research, lead magnets, opt-in pages, bridge pages, email drafts, and campaign planning. Run My AI Biz’s affiliate examples illustrate how these parts can be assembled into a tailored funnel.

AI does not guarantee commissions, and promotional content must accurately describe the offer and follow the relevant platform’s requirements. Claims, disclosures, links, and audience fit need human review.

Key factors:
- Whether the offer genuinely fits the audience.
- The accuracy of product descriptions and comparisons.
- Required disclosure language and placement.
- Tracking links and the customer experience after the click.

Start with one offer and one audience problem. Draft the funnel, verify the merchant’s current information, test links, and review every email and page before publication.

Run My AI Biz can provide educational examples while leaving offer selection and compliance checks to the owner.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can help research an offer, create a lead magnet, draft funnel pages, and prepare emails, but it cannot guarantee commissions. Start with one relevant offer, verify claims and links, and review required disclosures before publishing.
